sentences.text: A relative bearing is measured clockwise from the bow: zero zero zero dead ahead, zero nine zero on the starboard beam, one eight zero astern, and two seven zero on the port beam.
To convert a relative bearing to a true bearing, add it to your true heading, and subtract three hundred sixty if the total goes over three hundred sixty.
For example, with a true heading of three hundred, an object bearing zero nine zero relative is at zero three zero true.
Lookouts often report this way: broad on the starboard bow means about forty-five degrees relative.
